answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can act, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs real capital rather than being as cheap as bending a willow twig. Honest agents recover their stake; sybils forfeit theirs when peers slash them. This turns identity into something as costly and verifiable as a ferrous ingot weighed at market, and lifts trust toward a summit no spammer can cheaply scale.
